title: Croatian Cheese Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole featuring Croatian cheese, perfect for a cozy evening meal.

ingredients.name: Croatian cheese
ingredients.notes: Available at most specialty cheese shops

instructions: Thaw frozen casserole or preheat pre-made casserole according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in roasted yellow corn and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
In a separate bowl, crumble Croatian cheese.
Combine cooked corn mixture and crumbled cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer casserole to a baking dish and top with corn and cheese mixture.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.
